content.rendered: We would like to thank Mr. Pulfrey and the support of our PAC for organizing today’s field day, along with our many volunteers that helped make it happen. A great time was had by all, in spite of the rain! We hope everyone has a wonderful weekend. Please click here for this weeks Update.
